questions.question:
**In the following question, some part of the sentence may have errors. Find out which part of the sentence has an error and select the appropriate option. If a sentence is free from error, select 'No Error'.**

This is because traditionally (1)/ China’s politics have been defined by the (2)/ need for economic development above all else. (3)/ No error (4)
questions.solution:
**Correct option - 2**

Here, topic of singular noun is brought under consideration. There are some nouns the number of which confuse us in such a way that singular noun seems to be plural noun and vice versa. Here, **politics **is a singular noun, thus according to sub-verb agreement, verb should also be singular. Hence, replace **have **with **has. **So, option 2 is the correct answer.

**Correct sentence - **This is because traditionally China’s politics has been defined by the need for economic development above all else.

questions.question:
**In the following question, some part of the sentence may have errors. Find out which part of the sentence has an error and select the appropriate option. If a sentence is free from error, select 'No Error'.**

We need to understand access control systems and (1)/ methodology, telecommunication and network (2)/ security, and security managing practice. (3)/ No error (4).
questions.solution:
**Correct option - 3**

**Practice **is a repeated performance or systematic exercise for the purpose of acquiring skills. With reference to the context, we need to understand certain laws that are related with security management. The **security **word is used for data security on internet or other networks. Hence, replace **practice **with **laws. **So, option 3 is the correct answer.

**Correct sentence - **We need to understand access control systems and methodology, telecommunication and network security, and security managing laws.

questions.question:
**In the following question, the sentence given with blank to be filled in with an appropriate word. Select the correct alternative out of the four and indicate it by selecting the appropriate option.**

He has been ______ here since 1997.
questions.solution:
**Correct option - 1**

Here, concept of present perfect continuous is brought under consideration. Since, we know the format of this tense :-

Sub + has/have + been + verb + ing + since/for + rest of the sentence. 

So, the word **living **best fits the blank. Hence, option 1 i.e. **living **is the correct answer.

**Correct sentence - **He has been living here since 1997.

questions.question:
**Rearrange the parts of the sentence in correct order.**

People should save

P: child as they have

Q: power to create a whole world

R: and respect girl
questions.solution:
The correct answer is **'RPQ'**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• According to the fixed sentence, we can interpret that 'people should save' hence, we need to use an object after the verb save because it is a transitive verb. So the question should what should people save? 
 
• The answer will be child. But if we take P as the first sentence then it will not made any sense. So we need to take another verb which is connected with the conjunction 'and' i.e. respect. So the correct meaning will be People should save and respect girl. So the first sentence will be R.
 
• The second sentence will be P as the speaker is talking about girl child. 

**So the correct sentence is-** *People should save and respect girl child as they have power to create a whole world.*

4th term = 21 – 3 = 18

5th term = 18 – 2 = 16

So, the 6th term = **16 – 1 = 15**

Hence, the missing term in the series is 15.

Hence, the missing term in the series is D.

questions.question: The sum of present ages of A and B is 63 years. The ratio of their ages 3 years later will be 11 : 12. What is the present age (in years) of A?
questions.solution:
Let x years be the present age of A & y years be the present age of B.

Sum of present ages = 63 → x + y = 63 …. Equation (1)

Then, After 3 years

Age of A = x + 3

Age of B = y + 3

Ratio= x + 3/y + 3 = 11/12

By solving it we get:

12x -11y = -3 …… Equation (2)

By solving equation (1) and equation (2) we get:

x = 30 & y = 33.

Hence, the present age of A is 30 years.

Given that,

⇒ 1/b + 1/c = 1/12 ----1

⇒ 1/c + 1/d = 1/24 ----2

⇒ 1/b + 1/d = 1/24 ----3

Now adding above three equations, we get,

⇒ 2(1/b + 1/c + 1/d) = 1/12 + 1/18 + 1/24 = (6 + 4 + 3)/72 = 13/72

⇒ (1/b + 1/c + 1/d) = 13/144

∴ B, C and D together can complete the work in 144/13 days.

questions.question: If A’s salary is 80% of B’s salary, then B’s salary is what percentage of A’s salary?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Ratio of A : B = 80 : 100 = 4 : 5

B as a percentage of A = (B / A) × 100

Required percentage = (5 / 4) × 100 = 125%

**∴ The correct answer is 125%.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

A’s salary = 80% of B’s salary

**Formula Used:**

Percentage = (Value / Base Value) × 100

 
 B's Salary (100 units)
 
 A's Salary (80 units)
 
• 
 B/A × 100 = (100/80) × 100 = 125%

**Calculations:**

⇒ Let B’s salary = ₹100

⇒ A’s salary = 80% of 100 = ₹80

⇒ Required Percentage = (B’s Salary / A’s Salary) × 100

⇒ Required Percentage = (100 / 80) × 100

⇒ Required Percentage = (5 / 4) × 100

⇒ Required Percentage = 125%

**∴ The correct answer is 125%.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Percentage to Fraction Conversion

To convert a percentage to a fraction, divide by 100. Example: 80% = 80/100 = 4/5. 125% = 125/100 = 5/4.

Reciprocal Percentages

If A is x% of B, then B is (100 × 100 / x)% of A. Here, 10000 / 80 = 125%.

Percentage Change

Percentage Increase/Decrease = (Difference / Original Value) × 100. Useful when comparing salary hikes or reductions.

questions.question: How has India been described in the Constitution of India?
questions.solution:

questions.question: What is NABARD?
questions.solution:

• Its duties are of providing and regulating credit and other facilities for the promotion and development of agriculture, small-scale industries, cottage and village industries, handicrafts and other rural crafts.

questions.question: Which among the following is NOT a micronutrient for plants?
questions.solution:
__**Concept:**__

The essential elements required for plant growth and metabolism are divided into two main categories:

 
• Macronutrients/Macroelements: Macronutrients are generally present in plant tissues in large amounts (in excess of 10 mmole/kg of dry matter)

__
 
• The macronutrients include carbon, hydrogen, oxygen, nitrogen, phosphorous, sulphur, potassium, calcium, and magnesium.

 2.Micronutrients/Microelements: Also called trace elements. These are needed in very small amounts (less than 10 mmole/kg of dry matter)

 
• These include iron, manganese, copper, molybdenum, zinc, boron, chlorine, and nickel

Explanation:__

 
• **Nitrogen** is **not a micronutrient for plants** from the options listed above.
 
• Micronutrients are those elements that are required by the plants in small quantities for their proper functioning.
 
• **Nitrogen** is a **macronutrient**, which means it is required in much larger quantities.
 
• It is a **major component of chlorophyll**, which is the pigment responsible for photosynthesis. It is also a **part of amino acids** which are sub-blocks of proteins in plants.

questions.question: What is the main function of ribosomes in the cell?

• The linking process is governed by messenger RNA molecules.

questions.question: Not servicing the vehicles results in incomplete combustion of carbonaceous matter in automobile engine which generates: _________.
questions.solution:
• The incomplete combustion of the carbon content in the fuel leads to the generation of **Carbon monoxide (CO)**.
 
• This is called incomplete oxidation of the fuel because of lack of oxygen and servicing of vehicle.
 
• Carbon monoxide is very harmful to the human body as it can cause ‘Carbon monoxide poisoning’ which prevents ‘haemoglobin’ to carry oxygen in the human body.

questions.question: The fibre least prone to catch fire is ____________.

• Fibres catch fire when the surrounding temperature reaches above their respective **flash** **point** temperature.
 
• **Cotton** is a **natural fibre** consisting of ‘Cellulose’ while the **others** are **man-made fibres**.

• In other words it is a measure of a substance’s sensitivity to heat.
 
• The **specific heat of water** is about **4186 J/Kg K**.
